title: El Cafetal de Pluma, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: cafe-pluma (MAJESTIC): patio de secado de un cafetal en la sierra de Pluma Hidalgo, Oaxaca. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.EULALIA_RUIZ: Mexican woman from the Oaxaca sierra, coffee grower, 66 years old, brown skin, grey hair in a long braid, small gold earrings, a dark-green embroidered blouse, a long black skirt, a beige rebozo shawl on her shoulders, sandals, her hands empty.
chars.MATEO_RUIZ: Mexican man from Oaxaca, 30 years old, brown skin, short black hair, clean-shaven, a light-grey work shirt with rolled sleeves, a straw hat hanging on his back, brown work trousers, boots, his hands empty.
chars.RODRIGO_ARTEAGA: Mexican man, 34 years old, light skin, wavy dark-brown hair combed back, a trimmed beard, a navy-blue quilted vest over a white button-down shirt, a silver watch, beige chinos, brown leather loafers, his hands empty.
chars.SEVERIANO_ARTEAGA: Mexican coffee estate boss, 70 years old, tall, light-brown skin, white hair, a grey goatee, a brown felt cowboy hat, a black wool jacket over a cream shirt, a bolo tie, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_CAFETALPLUMA: Coffee farm in the mountains of Pluma Hidalgo, Oaxaca, in the morning: a concrete drying patio with coffee beans spread out, burlap sacks, an old adobe house with a tile roof on the left, green coffee plants and banana trees on misty mountain slopes behind, soft light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
